History of Present Illness:
36-year-old woman. One day of suprapubic discomfort, nausea and urinary urgency without burning. No vaginal discharge.

Physical Examination:
Suprapubic and right lower-quadrant tenderness; no costovertebral angle tenderness. Temperature 38.3 C; heart rate 100/min; BP 134/74 mmHg; respiratory rate 20/min; SpO2 98% on room air.

Laboratory Tests:
WBC: 14.0 10^9/L (reference 4.0-11.0)
Hemoglobin: 13.5 g/dL (reference 12.0-17.5)
Platelets: 269 10^9/L (reference 150-400)
Sodium: 137 mmol/L (reference 135-145)
Potassium: 3.9 mmol/L (reference 3.5-5.0)
Creatinine: 1.1 mg/dL (reference 0.6-1.3)
CRP: 108 mg/L (reference <5)
Lipase: 39 U/L (reference 13-60)
ALT: 29 U/L (reference 7-45)
AST: 32 U/L (reference 10-40)
Alkaline phosphatase: 99 U/L (reference 40-130)
Total bilirubin: 0.7 mg/dL (reference 0.2-1.2)
Serum pregnancy test: negative (reference negative)
Urinalysis: Negative leukocyte esterase and nitrite; 0-2 WBC/hpf; 0-2 RBC/hpf

Imaging Findings:
CT abdomen/pelvis: pelvic appendix measures 10 mm with surrounding stranding, abutting the bladder dome. No urinary obstruction or adnexal mass.
